skills.name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0)
skills.sdg8_connection: Short-term skill training aligned with NSQF; 400+ courses including AI, 5G, green hydrogen and drone technology
skills.benefit: Free skill training (7.5–30 hrs micro-credentials to full short-term courses), NSQF certificate, placement support
skills.application_method: Online via Skill India Digital portal or nearest PMKVY training centre

skills.name: Pradhan Mantri National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (PM-NAPS)
skills.sdg8_connection: On-the-job apprenticeship training; government pays 25% of stipend (up to ₹1,500/month) to employer via DBT
skills.benefit: 25% of monthly stipend (up to ₹1,500/month) paid by GoI via DBT; earn-while-you-learn with industry exposure
skills.application_method: Online via apprenticeshipindia.gov.in; employers register establishments and apprentices

skills.name: Jan Shikshan Sansthan (JSS) Scheme
skills.sdg8_connection: Community-based vocational training for non-literates, neo-literates and rural/urban disadvantaged groups
skills.benefit: Low-cost doorstep vocational training linked with NSQF certification; particular focus on women and rural youth
skills.application_method: Apply at nearest Jan Shikshan Sansthan centre (one in each district)

skills.name: PM-DAKSH
skills.sdg8_connection: Targeted skilling and employability for SC, OBC, EBC, DNT and safai karamchari communities
skills.benefit: Free skill training, stipend during training, toolkit support, placement assistance; training duration 10–365 days
skills.application_method: Online via pmasdaksh.dosje.gov.in; apply through registered training partners
skills.verification_note: Primarily targets SC, OBC, EBC and DNT communities; income limit varies by component — check official portal

skills.name: FutureSkills Prime Incentive Program
skills.sdg8_connection: Digital and emerging-tech skilling (AI, ML, Big Data, Cloud, IoT, Cybersecurity, AR/VR) for the IT/ITES workforce
skills.benefit: Subsidised/incentivised training in 10 emerging technologies; certification from industry-recognised bodies
skills.application_method: Online via futureskillsprime.in through empanelled training providers
skills.verification_note: ⚠️ Verify current enrolment windows on futureskillsprime.in — batch openings vary by course

skills.name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana 2.0 (DDU-GKY 2.0)
skills.sdg8_connection: Placement-linked rural skill training with guaranteed employment in formal sector
skills.benefit: Free residential/non-residential training (3–12 months), food, accommodation, post-placement support; 100% placement-linked
skills.application_method: Apply at nearest District Rural Development Agency (DRDA) or Common Service Centre
skills.verification_note: Updated as DDU-GKY 2.0 per May 2025 PIB announcement; eligibility may include up to age 45 in revised version — verify locally

skills.name: DAY-NULM – Employment through Skills Training & Placement (EST&P)
skills.sdg8_connection: Skill training and placement support for urban poor in cities/towns
skills.benefit: Free market-aligned skill training (3–6 months), placement support, post-placement tracking; implemented via Urban Local Bodies
skills.application_method: Apply at your City Livelihood Centre (CLC) or Urban Local Body office
skills.verification_note: Implemented by states/ULBs — enrolment depends on local batch availability; contact your city municipality

skills.name: DAY-NRLM (Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission)
skills.sdg8_connection: Rural self-employment and livelihood support through SHG networks, skill training and credit linkage
skills.benefit: SHG formation + revolving fund (₹15,000) + Community Investment Fund + bank credit linkage + skill training; interest subvention on loans
skills.application_method: Join or form a Self Help Group (SHG) in your village; contact Block Mission Management Unit

skills.name: Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETIs)
skills.provider: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) + Sponsor Banks
skills.sdg8_connection: Free short-duration self-employment training for rural youth to start their own businesses
skills.benefit: Free 2–6 week residential training in trades like tailoring, mobile repair, agri-business etc.; credit linkage support post-training
skills.application_method: Apply at nearest RSETI centre (one per district) or via lead bank in your district

skills.name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
skills.sdg8_connection: Seed funding for early-stage startups for prototype development and market entry
skills.benefit: Up to ₹20 lakh as grant for concept/prototype; up to ₹50 lakh as convertible debenture/debt for product development; disbursed via incubators
skills.application_method: Apply to SISFS-empanelled incubators via seedfund.startupindia.gov.in; startup must be DPIIT-recognised
skills.verification_note: ⚠️ Must be a DPIIT-recognised startup registered <5 years ago; apply through an approved incubator, not directly to DPIIT

skills.name: Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)
skills.sdg8_connection: Innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem via Atal Incubation Centres, Atal Tinkering Labs and challenge programmes
skills.benefit: Access to incubation (₹10 crore seed per AIC), Tinkering Labs in schools, mentoring networks and challenge grants; no direct cash benefit to individuals
skills.application_method: Through AIM-empanelled Atal Incubation Centres (AICs) or Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs) at your institution
skills.verification_note: ⚠️ This is an ecosystem/programme initiative — individual access is through participating institutions and incubators, not a direct scheme

skills.name: NIDHI Programme (National Initiative for Developing and Harnessing Innovations)
skills.sdg8_connection: Technology startup and deep-tech innovation support through incubators and accelerators
skills.benefit: Incubation support, mentoring, seed funding and infrastructure through DST-funded incubators; NIDHI framework includes multiple components (PRAYAS, EIR, SSS)
skills.application_method: Apply to DST-supported technology business incubators (TBIs) in your region via nidhi.dst.gov.in
skills.verification_note: ⚠️ Institutional programme — apply through a NIDHI-supported TBI, not directly to DST

skills.name: NIDHI-PRAYAS (Promoting and Accelerating Young and Aspiring Innovators & Startups)
skills.sdg8_connection: Prototype and early-stage innovation funding for technology entrepreneurs
skills.benefit: Up to ₹10 lakh per innovator for prototype development; supported through host incubator infrastructure
skills.application_method: Apply through NIDHI-PRAYAS host incubators listed on the DST NIDHI portal
skills.verification_note: ⚠️ Application is through host incubators, not directly to DST; check nidhi.dst.gov.in for active PRAYAS centres

skills.name: NIDHI-Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EIR)
skills.sdg8_connection: Entrepreneurship support for qualified professionals and PhD scholars to pursue tech startup ideas full-time
skills.education_req: PhD or 2+ years professional experience in science/engineering
skills.benefit: Monthly stipend of ₹30,000–₹60,000 for up to 2 years while pursuing a tech startup idea within a NIDHI incubator
skills.application_method: Apply through NIDHI EIR host incubators; selection is competitive with periodic call for applications
skills.verification_note: ⚠️ Requires PhD or significant professional experience; application through host TBI with periodic calls — check DST portal for open calls

skills.name: TIDE 2.0 (Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs)
skills.sdg8_connection: ICT and deep-tech entrepreneurship support through technology business incubators
skills.benefit: Incubation, mentoring, infrastructure and seed funding (up to ₹7 lakh as grant) through 51 TIDE 2.0 Technology Business Incubators
skills.application_method: Apply to one of the 51 TIDE 2.0 Technology Business Incubators listed on tide.meity.gov.in
skills.verification_note: ⚠️ Apply through an empanelled TIDE TBI; availability depends on each incubator's intake cycle

skills.name: ASPIRE (A Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry and Entrepreneurship)
skills.sdg8_connection: Rural entrepreneurship and agri-based industry incubation through Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs) and Technology Business Incubators (TBIs)
skills.benefit: Incubation support, mentoring and seed funding through ASPIRE Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs); focused on agri-tech and rural enterprises
skills.application_method: Apply to ASPIRE LBIs or TBIs listed on aspire.msme.gov.in
skills.verification_note: ⚠️ Programme-level scheme; apply through registered incubators — check aspire.msme.gov.in for active LBIs in your region

skills.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
skills.sdg8_connection: Credit-linked capital subsidy for setting up new micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors
skills.education_req: Class 8 pass (for projects above ₹10L manufacturing / ₹5L service)
skills.benefit: 15–35% margin money subsidy on project cost. Max project: ₹50L (manufacturing), ₹20L (service). Beneficiary contribution: 10% General / 5% Special categories (SC/ST/OBC/Women/Disabled/Ex-servicemen/NER/Hill areas/Border areas)
skills.application_method: Online application on kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal; existing units and those who already availed govt subsidy are NOT eligible
skills.verification_note: No income ceiling. Cannot have availed benefits under any other GoI/State Govt subsidy scheme previously

skills.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
skills.sdg8_connection: Collateral-free micro-enterprise credit for non-farm, non-corporate businesses (trading, manufacturing, services)
skills.benefit: Collateral-free loans in 4 tiers: Shishu (up to ₹50,000) | Kishore (₹50,001–₹5 lakh) | Tarun (₹5–₹10 lakh) | TarunPlus (₹10–₹20 lakh, for Tarun repayers only). No processing fee for Shishu. Women borrowers get preferential rates.
skills.application_method: Apply at any scheduled commercial bank, RRB, NBFC or MFI; or online via udyamimitra.in
skills.verification_note: Business must be non-farm and non-corporate. TarunPlus category only for those who have successfully repaid a Tarun loan.

skills.name: Stand-Up India Scheme
skills.provider: Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance
skills.sdg8_connection: Greenfield enterprise financing for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs through bank loans
skills.benefit: Composite bank loan of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore (75% of project cost). For SC/ST or women entrepreneurs. First-time venture (greenfield) only. 7-year repayment with 18-month moratorium. No collateral under CGSSI guarantee.
skills.application_method: Online via standupmitra.in or at any scheduled commercial bank branch
skills.verification_note: For SC/ST borrowers AND/OR women (either qualifies). Must be first-time venture. Borrower must not be in default with any bank.

skills.name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
skills.provider: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MoHUA) + DFS
skills.sdg8_connection: Working capital loans for urban street vendors to restart and expand livelihoods
skills.benefit: Collateral-free working capital loans in 3 progressive tranches: ₹15,000 (1st) → ₹25,000 (2nd) → ₹50,000 (3rd). 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment. UPI-linked RuPay credit card (₹30,000 limit) after 2nd tranche. Extended to 31 March 2030.
skills.application_method: Online via pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or nearest Common Service Centre or lending bank
skills.verification_note: Must be an urban street vendor with a Certificate of Vending or Identity Card issued by ULB, OR identified in the ULB vendor survey

skills.name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
skills.sdg8_connection: End-to-end support for traditional artisans and craftspeople in 18 specified trades
skills.benefit: PM Vishwakarma Certificate + ID card | ₹500/day stipend during skill training | ₹15,000 toolkit e-voucher | Collateral-free loan: ₹1 lakh (1st tranche) then ₹2 lakh (2nd tranche) at 5% interest | Digital transaction incentives
skills.application_method: Online via pmvishwakarma.gov.in or at Common Service Centre (CSC); Aadhaar + mobile number required
skills.verification_note: Covers 18 trades: Carpenter, Blacksmith, Goldsmith, Potter, Cobbler, Mason, Tailor, Barber, Washerman, and 9 more. Must not have availed PMEGP, PM SVANidhi or MUDRA in the past 5 years. Government employees not eligible.

skills.name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
skills.sdg8_connection: Support for existing micro food processing enterprises to formalise, upgrade and scale
skills.benefit: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy on project cost up to ₹10 lakh (max subsidy ₹3.5 lakh) for existing micro food enterprises; also supports SHG and FPO-based enterprises with higher grants
skills.application_method: Online via pmfme.mofpi.gov.in; apply through the nodal bank in your state
skills.verification_note: Only for EXISTING micro food processing enterprises (not new startups). Must be registered under Udyam Assist or equivalent.

skills.name: SFURTI (Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries)
skills.sdg8_connection: Cluster development for traditional industry groups (khadi, coir, jute, handicrafts) to improve competitiveness and employment
skills.benefit: Cluster-level funding of ₹2.5–₹10 crore for soft interventions (training, capacity building) and hard interventions (common facility centres, tools, equipment) for artisan clusters
skills.application_method: Cluster applications submitted by Implementing Agencies (NGOs, institutions, industry associations) — individual artisans benefit by joining a notified cluster
skills.verification_note: ⚠️ Not a direct individual scheme — benefits flow through industry clusters. Check if your trade/region has an active SFURTI cluster.

skills.name: National SC-ST Hub
skills.sdg8_connection: Entrepreneurship support, procurement facilitation and mentoring for SC/ST entrepreneurs in MSME ecosystem
skills.benefit: Procurement facilitation (25% public procurement reservation for MSMEs includes SC/ST sub-target), mentoring, credit facilitation, vendor development and skill training for SC/ST entrepreneurs
skills.application_method: Register on scsthub.in; workshops and programmes announced periodically
skills.verification_note: Must be an SC/ST entrepreneur running an MSME. Provides facilitation support, not direct cash benefit.

skills.name: Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme (ESDP)
skills.sdg8_connection: Short-duration entrepreneurship development and skill training programmes for aspiring entrepreneurs
skills.benefit: Low-cost/free short-term EDP and skill training programmes (1 week to 3 months) at MSME-DI centres and partner institutions across India
skills.application_method: Contact nearest MSME Development & Facilitation Office (MSME-DFO / MSME-DI) or check msme.gov.in for upcoming programmes
skills.verification_note: ⚠️ Programmes are announced periodically with varying schedules — check the MSME portal or your nearest MSME-DI for upcoming batches

skills.name: Coir Udyami Yojana
skills.sdg8_connection: Credit-linked subsidy for setting up coir processing and manufacturing enterprises
skills.benefit: 40% government subsidy on projects up to ₹10 lakh (max subsidy ₹4 lakh) for setting up coir units; balance financed by bank loan (55%) and beneficiary contribution (5%)
skills.application_method: Apply via coirboard.gov.in or nearest Coir Board regional office
skills.verification_note: Specific to coir industry enterprises. Coir Board verifies technical and commercial viability before sanctioning.

skills.name: Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme (SVEP)
skills.provider: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) under DAY-NRLM
skills.sdg8_connection: Rural micro-enterprise development through community cadres (Community Resource Persons for Enterprise Promotion — CRPs-EP)
skills.benefit: Start-up loan (₹50,000–₹1 lakh), enterprise promotion training, handholding support by CRPs-EP and business development services for rural micro-enterprises under NRLM SHG network
skills.application_method: Connect with your Block Mission Management Unit (BMMU) or Cluster Level Federation (CLF) under DAY-NRLM
skills.verification_note: Implemented via DAY-NRLM SHG ecosystem in specific blocks — availability depends on whether your block is a SVEP block

skills.name: NSFDC Skill Development Programmes
skills.provider: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC)
skills.sdg8_connection: Skill training and livelihood development for SC communities through SHG and individual beneficiary models
skills.benefit: Free/subsidised skill training in market-linked trades; credit linkage for self-employment post-training; implemented through State Channelising Agencies (SCAs)
skills.application_method: Apply via your State Channelising Agency (SCA) — usually the state SC Development Corporation
skills.verification_note: ⚠️ Income limit typically ₹3 lakh/year (double the poverty line income); apply through your state's SC Development Corporation, not directly to NSFDC

skills.name: Craftsmen Training Scheme (CTS) – ITI Training
skills.provider: Directorate General of Training (DGT) / Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship
skills.sdg8_connection: Long-duration (1–2 year) vocational training in 130+ trades at Industrial Training Institutes for formal employment and self-employment
skills.education_req: Class 8 pass minimum (Class 10 for certain trades)
skills.benefit: NSQF-aligned ITI certificate recognised by industry + government; training in engineering and non-engineering trades; SC/ST/Women fee concessions at government ITIs
skills.application_method: Annual admission via state ITI admission portal; check dgt.gov.in for centralised counselling calendar
skills.verification_note: Annual intake typically in July–August. SC/ST/OBC/Women get seat reservations and fee waivers at government ITIs as per state rules.

skills.name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY)
skills.sdg8_connection: Employment-linked financial incentive for first-time formal sector employees and employers creating additional jobs
skills.benefit: Part A (Employees): One-time incentive = 1 month's EPF wage, capped at ₹15,000, paid in instalments after 6 and 12 months of service. Part B (Employers): Up to ₹3,000/month per additional employee for 2 years (4 years in manufacturing). Total scheme outlay: ₹99,446 crore.
skills.application_method: Registration via EPFO UAN; Aadhaar-authenticated via Face Authentication on UMANG app; employer registers on Shram Suvidha portal
skills.verification_note: Must be a FIRST-TIME EPFO member (not previously registered). Monthly wage must be ≤₹1 lakh. Registration window: 1 Aug 2025 – 31 Jul 2027. Launched 15 Aug 2025 (formerly ELI Scheme).
